- Overestimate early in the 30-day horizon when sentiment is positive (sentiment > 0.2), especially after recent spikes.
- Underestimate when sentiment is negative (sentiment < -0.5) or shows strong downward momentum.
- Overshoot after sharp upward sentiment spikes; reduce forecast peak by 5–10% for 3–5 day lag.
- Mean-revert toward recent 7–14 day average if sentiment is neutral or mildly positive.
- Avoid overreacting to single-day sentiment extremes; smooth transitions with 3-day moving average filter.
- If sentiment is rising steadily, forecast should lag slightly behind true price momentum by 1–2 days.
- For 30-day horizon, if true outcome exceeds forecast by >10% in 3+ consecutive days, reduce next forecast by 2–5% to avoid overcorrection.
